scenes.say: This week Formula E put its Gen4 car on track for official testing. It's the most powerful car the series has ever had.
Four hundred fifty kilowatts in the race, six hundred in attack mode and qualifying. That's over eight hundred horsepower.
Under braking it puts up to seven hundred kilowatts back into the battery. The brakes work as a generator.
For the first time the series has permanent all-wheel drive. All four wheels drive, all race long.
Gen4 gets from zero to two hundred kilometres an hour in four point four seconds.
The first race is in Mexico City on January sixteenth. Twenty-one races and twelve teams this season.
The Formula E calendar is on LapRadar.

title: Formula E Gen4 hits the track: 600 kW and all-wheel drive
